暮年太子：每天增加一点精神最新章节_第499章 火烧杂都第1页_暮年太子：每天增加一点精神欣诚则灵吖_热点小说网
> 第499章 火烧杂都（第1页）
不过盏茶功夫，四万多杂族士卒被杀得七零八落。
剩下的想要逃走，却被分身张伟轻松追上，一一斩杀，几乎没有几个人能够逃得过他的断剑射杀。
他的速度快得惊人，如同一道闪电；剑法凌厉而狠辣，每一剑都精准地命中目标；如同一个死神，收割着生命，为死去的大夏百姓报仇雪恨。
曾北神色一冷，看着众人看着他的眼神，楼汐长的又漂亮，训练期间成绩又好，501宿舍，除了姜忆，其实都很团结，甚至包括曲幻，后面也很团结。
吴冕离开学校，接着到周慧的家里一趟，随即发现在她的房子中还有一道魁梧的身影，看起来五大三粗的，脸上还有道狰狞疤痕，给人一种不怒而威的感觉。
原本吴冕对此将信将疑，这已经超出人体力学的范畴了，可现在见到自身上的变化，吴冕却有些相信了。
“那个舒浅对蛊毒还真有几把刷子，你的情况越来越好了，现在一天已经能清醒两次了。”叶六对这样的情况很是满意。
他原本还以为吴冕只是剑术高，天赋好，现在才发现，对方可能也经历过实战洗礼，甚至可能杀过人。
此刻餐厅已经做了三三两两的人，他们都在说昨天晚上的大风，就是老板都很迷惑，他们这里虽然是在山上，可是这又不是什么深山，山也不算多高大，这样大的山风还是第一次见。
之前单看白苏苏觉得惊艳无比，气质也让人念念不忘，可现在有了相似的对象，再看白苏苏，似乎也没有那么让人惊艳了。
夜南山大开大合，步步紧逼，不断对华菲发动攻击，每一棍都力大沉猛，每一棍都让华菲难以招架，倒退几步。
他一边说着，一边闪避着楚鸿的攻击，虽然不能闪躲完全，但是，还是能躲过很多次攻击的。
锻骨丹是很难消化的，一般人就算吃下去，不但会完整拉出来，还会重金属中毒。
“听说韩宇哲最近有点麻烦，是真的？”洛辰熙见到涂花期，问道。
“京都的车子，还有司机，会是谁呢？”凌霄的心里暗暗地琢磨着，也没停留，继续向办公楼走去。
其他的几个兽人看着巴里，被两个雌性前后贴着，不停的挑逗，看的他们心痒难耐。居然不怕死的各个围了过来。
“大，大人。请您原谅，再给我一次机会吧？！！”恶魔兽看着眼前看似平凡的男子，内心却是恐惧无比。
姜烈此刻呼吸困难，他不断挣扎试图摆脱如铁钳般的手掌，嘴里同时开出天价想收买李逍逸，可惜。。

“唉。。我说，你们怎么都不说话，我好不容易偷了这辆车来，你们什么也没干，还一个个苦拉着脸，别这么紧张好不好，还有你们不知道吗？再不说两句，以后可能就没机会说了，哈哈！”胡八一说完自己先笑了起来。
待得众人退尽，冥皇袍袖一拂，掩上庙门，原本亮堂的神庙顿成一片幽深世界，他走到圣像后面，揭开帷幔，闪身入内。
跟着修罗一声怒吼！似乎连天空都为之色变！他身体猛然一震！顿时数条金龙真气在他的双拳上环绕，而修罗瞳孔中的紫光也达到耀眼的程度，跟着一股强烈的窒息感压住李逍逸的咽喉，他知道。。对方要出杀招了。。

> Chapter 499 Burning Zadu (Page 1)
In just one cup of tea, more than 40,000 soldiers of various ethnic groups were killed in pieces.
The rest wanted to escape, but their clone Zhang Wei easily caught up and killed them one by one. Almost no one could escape his broken sword.
His speed is astonishingly fast, like a bolt of lightning; his swordsmanship is sharp and ruthless, and every sword hits the target accurately; like a god of death, harvesting lives and avenging the dead people of Daxia.
Zeng Bei's expression turned cold and he saw the way everyone looked at him. Lou Xi was beautiful and had good grades during training. In dormitory 501, except for Jiang Yi, everyone was actually very united, including Qu Huan, who was also very united later on.
Wu Mian left school and went to Zhou Hui's house. He immediately found a burly figure in her house. He looked tall and thick, and there was a ferocious scar on his face, which gave people a feeling of power without anger.
Wu Mian was initially doubtful about this, as it was beyond the scope of human body mechanics, but now that he saw the changes in himself, Wu Mian began to believe it.
"That Shu Qian is really good at poisoning. Your condition is getting better and better. You can wake up twice a day now." Ye Liu was very satisfied with this situation.
He originally thought that Wu Mian only had good swordsmanship and talent, but now he discovered that the other party might have experienced actual combat, and might even have killed someone.
At this moment, there are already people in the restaurant in twos and threes. They are all talking about the strong wind last night. Even the boss is very confused. Although they are on the mountain, this is not a deep mountain, and the mountain is not that high. This is the first time I have seen such a strong mountain wind.
In the past, just looking at Bai Susu, I thought she was extremely stunning, and her temperament was unforgettable. But now that I have a similar partner, looking at Bai Susu, she doesn't seem so amazing anymore.
Ye Nanshan opened and closed, pressing forward step by step, constantly launching attacks on Hua Fei. Every stick was so powerful and heavy that Hua Fei was unable to resist and took a few steps back.
As he spoke, he dodged Chu Hong's attacks. Although he couldn't dodge completely, he was still able to dodge many attacks.
The Bone Forging Pill is difficult to digest. Even if an average person eats it, not only will it be completely removed, but they will also be poisoned by heavy metals.
"I heard that Han Yuzhe has been in trouble recently, is it true?" Luo Chenxi asked when he saw Tu Huaqi.
"Who is the car and the driver in Kyoto?" Ling Xiao secretly wondered in his heart, and continued walking towards the office building without stopping.
The other orcs looked at Barry, being teased and teased by two females, which made them itchy. People who were not afraid of death gathered around him.
"Sir, please forgive me and give me another chance?!" Demonmon looked at the seemingly ordinary man in front of him, but his heart was filled with fear.
Jiang Lie was having trouble breathing at the moment. He kept struggling to get rid of the iron-like grasp, and at the same time offered a sky-high price to buy Li Xiaoyi, but it was a pity. .
"Oh... I said, why are you not talking? I managed to steal this car and you didn't do anything. You are all grimacing. Don't be so nervous, okay? Don't you know? If you don't say a few words, you may not have a chance to say anything in the future, haha!" Hu Bayi started laughing after he finished speaking.
After everyone had retreated, the Underworld Emperor flicked his sleeves and closed the temple door. The originally bright temple suddenly turned into a deep world. He walked behind the icon, opened the curtain, and stepped inside.
Follow Shura with a roar! It seems that even the sky changes color! His body shook suddenly! Suddenly, several Golden Dragon Qi surrounded his fists, and the purple light in Shura's pupils also reached a dazzling level, followed by a strongThe suffocation feeling pressed down on Li Xiaoyi's throat, he knew it. . The other party is about to make a killing move. .
